title: The Kirata
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; cool Himalayan gold-hour with blue peaks; refined linework
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

arjuna.face: Young warrior, thin dark mustache, focused calm
arjuna.costume: Cream ascetic/simple dhoti, bow when armed

shiva.face: Divine serene, soft third-eye glow optional
shiva.costume: Tiger skin or white, rudraksha, trident, luminous aura

plates.beat_text: To win the weapons of heaven, Arjuna climbs alone into the high Himalaya.
must_show: Premium painted comic Himalayan peaks and pine path
Lone Arjuna climbing or walking into mountains
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra. Wide Himalayan landscape: snow peaks, pine forests, golden hour mist. Lone young warrior Arjuna in simple cream dhoti and topknot climbs a mountain path with bow. Epic solitude. Ornate lotus frame. Match Ep01 gold comic style language NOT the bird-garden training scene. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: There he stands in fierce penance — still as stone, mind fixed on Mahadeva.
must_show: Arjuna in tapas: standing on one leg or arms raised / still meditation on mountain ledge
Same Arjuna face lock, no peacock
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Arjuna in fierce mountain penance on a rocky ledge — still posture, thin mustache, black topknot, cream dhoti, mind fixed upward. Snow peaks and pines behind. Soft divine light. Ornate lotus frame. Same character lock, refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: A terrible boar charges through the pines. Two arrows leave two bows at once.
must_show: Wild boar charging; Arjuna drawing bow; second arrow path or hunter presence suggested
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra action. Fierce stylized wild boar charges through pine forest. Arjuna draws bow; a second arrow from off-frame or hunter side flies too. Dynamic golden-cool mountain light. Ornate lotus frame. Stylized not photoreal, not gory.

plates.beat_text: A mountain hunter claims the kill. Arjuna will not yield the honor of the shot.
must_show: Kirata hunter and Arjuna face each other over the fallen boar
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Mountain clearing: rugged kirata hunter in leaf-hide dress with bow faces young Arjuna over a fallen boar. Argument of who shot first — proud stance both. Cool gold pine light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Bow meets bow. The kirata matches Arjuna blow for blow — and the forest shakes.
must_show: Dynamic duel: Arjuna and kirata with bows clashing
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra action duel. Arjuna and the kirata hunter clash with bows in mountain forest — matched strength, dramatic poses, flying leaves. Cool gold light. Ornate lotus frame. Stylized energy not gore, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Arjuna’s strength fails against an equal. He falls, astonished, at a hunter’s feet.
must_show: Arjuna kneeling or fallen astonished before standing kirata
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Arjuna kneels astonished on mountain ground before the proud kirata hunter who still stands with bow. Wonder and humility. Soft gold light through pines. Ornate lotus frame. Dignified, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Then the kirata shines with a thousand suns. It is Shiva, the Lord, smiling.
must_show: Divine reveal: Shiva luminous with jata, crescent, trident, aura replacing hunter
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Divine revelation: the hunter becomes Lord Shiva — jata matted locks, crescent moon, soft third-eye glow, trident, luminous cream-gold aura, serene smile. Arjuna bows in awe. Mountain forest radiant. Ornate lotus frame. Sacred charming not photoreal horror.

plates.beat_text: Pleased by courage and devotion, Mahadeva grants the Pashupatastra.
must_show: Shiva blessing Arjuna; glowing divine weapon or arrow of light (Pashupatastra)
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Lord Shiva places a glowing divine weapon or arrow of light into Arjuna’s hands — Pashupatastra gift. Arjuna receives with bowed head, thin mustache, topknot. Soft sacred gold light on mountain. Ornate lotus frame. Refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: So the archer who saw only the eye is given the weapon that ends the war of ages.
must_show: Premium quality gold closing mood like Ep01 wide-gold
Arjuna blessed on mountain peak, soft Shiva presence or afterglow
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold Himalayan peak peace like Ep01 plate-wide-gold mood. Arjuna stands renewed with bow, soft divine afterglow of Shiva’s blessing. Ornate lotus frame. Refined charming quality, not photoreal.
